Metadata.title: Bon Sang
Metadata.description: Understand what a blood donation is used for, check your eligibility and find a blood drive near you.

hero.title: Understand, check, find a blood drive.
hero.lead: Blood cannot be stored for long and cannot be manufactured. Here is what you need to act with confidence.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: What a donation is used for, the journey of a blood bag and who it treats every day.

test.title: Check
test.body: A quick questionnaire based on EFS criteria to find out whether you can donate.

act.title: Act
act.body: The map of blood drives around you and a reminder as soon as you are eligible again.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: Check your eligibility in a few questions.
how.s2: Spot a nearby blood drive on the map.
how.s3: On the day: confidential interview, donation, snack.
how.s4: We remind you when you can donate again.

cta.title: Ten minutes are enough to help up to three people.
cta.body: Start by checking whether you are eligible — no commitment.

Footer.disclaimer: Independent information site, not affiliated with the Établissement français du sang. Blood drives come from EFS open data.
Footer.privacy: No personal data is sent to a server: your log and reminders stay in your browser.

NotFoundPage.title: Page not found
NotFoundPage.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

understand.title: Understanding blood donation
understand.lead: What a donation is used for, the journey of a blood bag from drive to patient, and the key figures.

whoItHelps.title: Who it helps
whoItHelps.lead: Cystic fibrosis, Steinert's disease, sickle cell disease: patients for whom donation changes daily life.

eligibility.title: Can I donate?
eligibility.lead: A questionnaire based on the official EFS criteria. The result is indicative: the pre-donation interview prevails.

collections.title: Blood drives near you
collections.lead: The map and list of upcoming blood drives, based on EFS open data.

tracker.title: My log
tracker.lead: Your donation log, your badges and the date you can donate again — stored in your browser.

about.title: About
about.lead: Sources, methodology and legal notices. This site is not affiliated with the EFS.
